record.question: Arjuna Awards are given to individuals for:
options: Outstanding contribution towards promotion of international understanding, goodwill among the people of the world.
Showing bravery in the face of enemy attack
Outstanding contribution for enhancing the glory of the game
record.explanation: Answer D: Outstanding contribution for enhancing the glory of the game. Arjuna Awards recognize sustained outstanding sporting performance and associated qualities. Of the printed descriptions, enhancing the glory of the game is the sporting one; the others concern literature, international understanding or military gallantry. The original 2017 Sports Ministry announcement specifies consistency of performance over four years. Historical/source note: The 2017 award criteria: sporting performance, not a reward for every general contribution to promoting games. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1500322&lang=2&reg=48. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
